explanation: The absolute majority of 1987 was not won from opposition: it was won by a government already in office, twenty-one months old, brought down by a censure motion the voters were then asked to judge. This election is what put that government there and what made it a minority — four parties in the Assembly and a fifth, the PRD, holding enough seats to deny anyone a majority. The atlas argues the sequence rather than an inevitability: without a minority Cavaco government there is no censure motion, and without the censure motion there is no election in July 1987 for a majority to be won at.
